method.contrast: WCAG 2.2 ratio from relative luminance; pass or fail on the unrounded ratio; printed to two decimals
method.lightness: OKLab L (Ottosson), the grayscale proof the Phase 2 palette lab used
method.grayscale_swatch: The neutral gray with the same relative luminance, so a gray swatch keeps the color's contrast
method.simulation: Machado, Oliveira and Fernandes (2009), severity 1.0, applied in linear sRGB; captures apply the same matrices through SVG feColorMatrix, which works in linear RGB
method.black_only: Black ink coverage on White paper that gives the same luminance, dot gain ignored

thresholds.note: Fills inside a scale may sit under 3 to 1 when every value prints on or beside them (Rule 05.5, Gate 2 contrast table)

turnout_2024.source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Current Population Survey Voting and Registration Supplement, Table 4a, reported voting for states, November 2024, 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 6, 2026. Self-reported voting among citizens 18 and over; state margins of error reach 5.6 points.

jobs.window_reason: Every jobs chart on this sheet runs from January 2022 to September 2026, the window S13 and S14 use: three full years before the January 2025 inauguration and every month since. The 12-month periods end each September, so none splits at the inauguration.
jobs.source_line: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Employment Statistics, all employees by industry, seasonally adjusted, January 2022 to September 2026, United States, via FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis. Retrieved November 6, 2026. August and September 2026 are preliminary and will be revised.

capture_verification.method: Each probed swatch is sampled in its capture, 15 percent in from its left edge and a quarter down, and compared with the token color (normal), the luma grayscale of CSS filter grayscale(1) (grayscale), or this script's Machado simulation (the three color-vision captures)
